    Armory

    Every weapon is tuned for distinct trade-offs. Headshots multiply damage and leg hits do 75 percent, so a clean head hit often ends a duel before it starts. Accuracy drops when you move, jump or spray, and improves when you crouch or aim down sights.

    Economy

    Cash carries between rounds. If you die, you lose your primary weapon and armor, so a risky push costs more than a single round.

    • Winning a round pays more than losing one, but a loss still keeps you in the game.
    • Armor soaks up half of each hit until it is used up.
    • The Longbow one-shots at any range, but it is slow to cycle and inaccurate until you scope.
    • Bots hear gunfire. Unscoped sprays near them bring the whole room.

    Map

      Operatives

      Two squads, ten original operatives. Pick one to play. Your squad's opposition fills the range as bots, each with the look and temperament of its own operative: some aim better, some run faster, some soak more damage.

      Your record

      Finish a match to set your first record. It is saved in this browser only.
